title: RVS Holidays
summary: A travel and vehicle rental website with a fleet list, booking enquiries, reviews and an admin panel the owner runs.
problem: The business relied on word of mouth. Customers had no place to see the vehicles, prices or past trips, and every enquiry came as a phone call with the same questions.
solution: A fast, mobile-first site with the full fleet, vehicle pages, a booking enquiry form, photo gallery and customer reviews. The owner updates all of it from a phone-friendly admin panel, with no developer needed.

features.title: Fleet and vehicle pages
features.description: Every vehicle with photos, capacity and details, with filters.

features.title: Booking enquiries
features.description: Enquiry form on every vehicle; the owner gets an email and tracks status in the admin.

features.title: Reviews and gallery
features.description: Customers post reviews; the owner approves them. Trip photos by category.

features.title: Owner admin panel
features.description: Vehicles, enquiries, gallery, reviews and site settings, usable from a phone.

features.title: Search-ready
features.description: Fast pages and SEO basics so the business shows up on Google.

aiNote: AI drafted the PRD, screen mockups for desktop and mobile, and first-draft copy that the client reviewed.
results: The agency now has a link to send every customer
The owner edits the site without a developer
